subject.title: feat(android): copy or save rendered widgets as images from the chat transcript

question: Should existing Android transcript widgets expose copy/save PNG actions through their long-press interaction once the contributor supplies direct device-flow proof?
rationale: This is a new default user-facing Android interaction, and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human acceptance rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Accept the interaction with proof
options.body: Retain the long-press actions, require redacted device evidence for the full flow, and review the rebased head once Android checks finish.

options.title: Narrow the Android UX
options.body: Request a different placement or scope for export controls if long-press actions on all transcript widgets are not the desired product behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the interaction with proof
recommendation.body: Retain the long-press actions, require redacted device evidence for the full flow, and review the rebased head once Android checks finish.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available contributor with direct history across the companion widget-export workstreams.
